title: Show a short toast message
summary: A toast is a short status message that appears briefly.
introduction: A toast is a short status message that appears briefly. Your task: Change the toast to a short completion message.
learningObjectives: Change the toast to a short completion message.
Explain the example for show a short toast message

blocks.text: A toast is a short status message that appears briefly. Its open state should stay connected to React state.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.

blocks.title: Show a short toast message

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `IonToast` is a temporary message. Its dismiss callback keeps the stored open state in step.
`useState` gives React a remembered value and a setter. Call the setter to ask React to show the next value.
`IonContent` owns the Ionic screen's scrolling content area. It works inside the starter app's page structure.

blocks.text: The button opens a two-second message, then the dismiss event resets the state.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A disappearing toast should not be the only place for information the reader must keep. Use persistent text for important errors.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the toast to a short completion message.
